This '''Unidentified Sun Leader wingman''' flew a [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE Fighter]] and was part of [[Revos Spaceport]]'s TIE Fighter group.

==History==
{{Quote|Base, copy. Returning home. He had him, Base. Why the change?''"<br />"''New orders. Come on in.''"<br />"''Base, will comply.|[[Unidentified Sun Leader pilot|Sun Leader]] to [[Control Aleph-One]] regarding his wingman|<ref name="X-Wing: Wraith Squadron" />}}
During [[Wraith Squadron]]'s [[Mission to Storinal]], one of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] commando squadron's objectives was to steal four of [[Revos Spaceport]]'s [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE Fighters]], which were kept in constant readiness in case of an attack. When Wraith [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Hohass Ekwesh]] strafed the spaceport with his [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]], it caused an emergency blackout throughout the spaceport. What the Wraiths didn't count on were the two TIE Fighters, piloted by [[Unidentified Sun Leader pilot|Sun Leader]] and his wingman, that launched and proceeded to pursue Ekwesh.<ref name="X-Wing: Wraith Squadron" />

Simultaneously, the group of [[Garik Loran]] and [[Atril Tabanne]] managed to capture [[Bunker Aleph-One]], the spaceport's command bunker. Pretending to be the controller killed by Tabanne, Loran issued the recall command for the TIE Fighters just when the wingman was about to vape Ekwesh's fighter. Upon landing their craft alongside the other TIEs that didn't launch, Loran's deception was caught and the information was relayed immediately to the wingman and Sun Leader. They tried to relaunch their fighters but were quickly shot down by the other two TIEs; piloted by [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] and [[Falynn Sandskimmer]].<ref name="X-Wing: Wraith Squadron" />
